details: The agent CLI opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay endpoint (default wss://msclaude.ai, defined in dist/config.js) and connects inbound WebSocket `terminal_input` messages directly into a locally spawned shell PTY (`process.env.SHELL || '/bin/bash'` on Unix, `powershell.exe` on Windows) via `ptyProcess.write(data)` in dist/terminal.js, streaming PTY output back over the same socket (dist/connection.js). Any party able to send messages through the relay session can execute arbitrary commands on the host running the CLI. dist/service.js also modifies the user's PATH to prepend `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`, and dist/tunnel.js issues `ping` / `http.request` reachability probes to the relay. Publisher identity is inconsistent: package.json declares repository `github.com/yilee/agentlink`, while the README references `github.com/kailunshi_microsoft/AgenticWorker` and the product name `msclaude`, so the operator of the relay is not clearly attributable to a known vendor.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
